Mac Mini Ständer zur thermischen Optimierung (12-18)

https://makerworld.com/de/models/2920408-mac-mini-thermal-optimization-stand-12-18#profileId-3267678

Keep your Intel Mac Mini cool and prevent thermal throttling!

 

This ventilated vertical stand is designed specifically for Intel Mac Mini models (2012, 2014, and 2018).

By removing the stock rubber bottom cover and elevating the Mac, this stand opens up the internal airflow, eliminating the heat-trap effect of the original design.

### 🌟 Features

* Maximum Airflow: Elevated design with clean side grill vents for superior heat dissipation.
* Full Port Access: The rear cutout ensures all your cables (HDMI, Thunderbolt, USB, Power) fit perfectly without stress.
* Perfect Fit: Snug fit that respects Apple's clean aesthetic lines.

### 🖨️ Printing Settings

* Material: PETG, ABS, or ASA (Highly recommended over PLA due to the high operating temperatures of Intel Macs).
* Layer Height: 0.20mm or 0.24mm.
* Walls/Perimeters: 2 to 3.
* Infill: 10% - 15% (Gyroid or Grid).
* Supports: None needed. Print it flat on the bed as oriented.

### 🔧 How to Use

* Remove the stock black bottom cover of your Mac Mini.
* Place the Mac Mini carefully onto this 3D-printed stand, ensuring the rear cutout aligns with the ports.
